description: This file defines an Angular standalone component named 'TaskListComponent', which manages a list of tasks, allowing editing, toggling completion, and deletion of tasks. It interacts with a TaskService for data operations.

classes.name: TaskListComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for displaying and managing a list of tasks, supporting editing, toggling completion, and deletion.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing of a specified task by setting signals with task's current data.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the edited task data via the TaskService, then resets editing state.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the editing process by resetting the editing signal.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of the specified task.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deletes the specified task using the TaskService.

methods.name: trackById
methods.description: Track function for ngFor, uniquely identifying tasks by their id.
